_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Provisioning Technical Documentation Submission Schedule (PTDSS)
summary: Establishes the schedule of actions, completion dates, and a checklist of events used to monitor and coordinate the provisioning technical documentation submission process.
use_relationship:
The Provisioning Technical Documentation Submission Schedule (PTDSS) establishes the schedule of important actions and completion dates in the provisioning process and includes a checklist of events schedules in the provisioning process that are used to monitor such events.  PTDSS are used to schedule various actions in the provisioning process that are interdependent, since a delay in one area can have a serious cumulative effect on the schedule for making concurrent delivery of repair parts and equipment.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, intended use information, and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task described in the solicitation or contract.

This DID is applicable to all Coast Guard contracts for the acquisition of cutters and boats and should be tailored appropriately to each program.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The PTDSS shall be in Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The PTDSS shall contain a list in chronological order starting with the major events in the provisioning process, established completion dates for each action, listed number of Provisioning Technical Documentation (PTD) submissions, and the proposed schedule for PTD submission.

children.title: The PTDSS shall identify each PTD submission
children.content: The PTDSS shall identify each PTD submission to its Ship Work Breakdown Structure (SWBS) and component nomenclature.  The dates shall be identified and shall take into account the elements of time set forth in the contract for delivery of end item equipment, data product Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) deliverables, and the Provisioning Performance Schedule (PPS) requirements.

children.title: The PTDSS shall contain outlined monthly percentage
children.content: The PTDSS shall contain outlined monthly percentage illustrations planned and ultimately, completed submittals.

children.title: The PTDSS items that were mutually agreed
children.content: The PTDSS items that were mutually agreed to shall be identified.

children.title: Source documents such as specifications, drawings
children.content: Source documents such as specifications, drawings, master erection schedules and allowance list for similar ships shall be identified in determining the number of PTD submittals.

children.title: The PTDSS shall include a chronicle list
children.content: The PTDSS shall include a chronicle list of the major events in the provisioning process and completion dates for each event.
